research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Uplight is researching systems for providing instant rebates before transactions are completed, as described in 'Energy product instant rebate engine,' which standardizes customer and rebate data from multiple utilities. The company is also developing methods for instant rebates related to demand response enrollment and clawbacks. Additionally, Uplight is working on adaptive thermal comfort learning for optimized HVAC control and setpoint adjustment-based duty cycling to reduce energy consumption. These areas reflect a focus on customer-centric energy solutions.

about_short_description.short_description: Uplight provides end-to-end customer-centric technology solutions.

product.name: Energy Efficiency & Electrification
product.description: Tools and programs that help residential and business customers manage and reduce their energy use through personalized reports, marketplaces, portals, alerts, and APIs.

product.name: Rates Engagement
product.description: Services that assist customers in selecting and optimizing their energy rate plans through reports, coaching emails, and alerts to increase adoption and engagement.

product.name: Demand Management
product.description: A platform that unifies demand-side resources through behavioral and automated demand response and virtual power plants to harness flexible load at scale.

product.name: Demand Response Programs
product.description: Programs designed to incentivize and manage customer participation in reducing or shifting energy use during peak demand periods.

product.name: Distributed Energy Resource Management System (DERMS)
product.description: A system that manages and optimizes distributed energy resources to provide grid services and enhance energy flexibility.

product.name: Virtual Power Plants (VPPs)
product.description: A platform that aggregates and orchestrates distributed energy resources to function as a single power plant for grid support and energy market participation.
